title: Get TikTok account Webhook configurations
content_data:
Use this endpoint to retrieve the existing configurations for Webhook events related to your TikTok account activities at the developer app level. ## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/business/webhook/list/ **Method** GET **Parameters** ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |--- |--- |--- | | app_id {Required} | string | ID of your developer application.

You can find the App ID by navigating to [My Apps](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/apps/) > App Detail > Basic Information. | | secret {Required} | string | Secret of your developer application.

You can find the Secret by navigating to [My Apps](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/apps/) > App Detail > Basic Information. | | event_type {Required} | enum | The type of Webhook event that you subscribe to.

Enum values:
  • `VIDEO`: Post publishing events, which provide you with real-time updates on the status of content published via specific TikTok API endpoints.
    • To learn more about the schema and sample payload of the events within this event category, see [Post publishing events](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1810515090228226).
  • `COMMENT`: comment update event, including the event `comment.update`.
    • To learn more about the schema and sample payload of the event within this event category, see [Comment update event](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1810515104773122).
| ``` ### Example #### Retrieve an existing Webhook configuration ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request GET 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/business/webhook/list/?app_id={{app_id}}&secret={{secret}}&event_type=VIDEO' (/code) ``` #### Retrieve an empty Webhook configuration ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request GET 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/business/webhook/list/?app_id={{app_id}}&secret={{secret}}&event_type=VIDEO' (/code) ``` ## Response ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |code |number|Response code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix-Return Code](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097). | |message|string|Response message. For details, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |request_id |string|The log ID of a request, which uniquely identifies the request. | |data |object|Returned data.| #| app_id | string | ID of your developer application. | #| event_type| string | The type of Webhook event that you subscribe to.

Enum values:
  • `VIDEO`: Post publishing events, which provide you with real-time updates on the status of content published via specific TikTok API endpoints.
    • To learn more about the schema and sample payload of the events within this event category, see [Post publishing events](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1810515090228226).
  • `COMMENT`: comment update event, including the event `comment.update`.
    • To learn more about the schema and sample payload of the event within this event category, see [Comment update event](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1810515104773122).
| #| callback_url | string | Returned only when the corresponding event configuration exists for your developer app.

The callback URL.

For example, if `event_type` is `VIDEO` and `callback_url` is not returned in the response, your developer app doesn't have an existing post publishing event Webhook configuration.| #| item_list | string[] | Returned only when `event_type` is `COMMENT` and `item_list` is configured for the developer app (`app_id`).

The IDs of the specific TikTok posts that you will receive comment update event notifications for. | ``` ### Example #### Retrieve an existing Webhook configuration ```xcodeblock (code Success-Response http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": { "app_id": "{{app_id}}", "callback_url": "{{callback_url}}", "event_type": "VIDEO" } } (/code) ``` #### Retrieve an empty Webhook configuration ```xcodeblock (code Success-Response http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": { "app_id": "{{app_id}}", "event_type": "VIDEO" } } (/code) ```
